operation: Collect distinct resolved links from lesson-page title anchors, then check up to six scroll results and prioritize newly observed links; save at most input.max_items while excluding input.exclude_urls.
assumptions: Lesson/document destinations are linked from the title anchors in the page list.
limitations: The observed index is a static list; if unseen listings use another selector, or scrolling reveals no candidate links, fewer items may be saved.
